learned_rules:
- **MIGRATED: buy the pullback, 10–60% off the local high** (owner). It must hold above the hourly low, with 5m volume ≥ $10k and buys > sells (V1, V6). Within 10% of the high: PASS, blocker "chasing" (near-high skips went 6 ran / 18 dumped; CATCULUS −59%, SI −38%).
- **A spike is chasing even 10–20% off the high.** If the last 5m candle is up >25%, or a green spike runs >3x the hourly pace, wait for it to retrace and print a higher low (PILLSEY −31%, V1).
- **Shallow band (10–20% off the high):** only the meta's flow leader, and only with 5m at or above hourly pace. Otherwise PASS, blocker "flow below pace" (HYPERCHAN #1).
- **Name the target before buying, ≥ 1.5x from entry:** prior high, POC, 0.618 extension or a breakout. If the only level sits below 1.5x: PASS, blocker "target below initials" (SWAN topped at its own 1.4x).
- **Conviction:** hard lines passed + live flow (5m ≥ $10k, buys > sells) + named target ≥ 1.5x = **7** (owner). **8** = 7 + leader/original of a live meta OR verified low bundle_pct. **9** = leader + low bundles + 20–60% pullback + 5m ≥ hourly pace (the CATBOT/FLOATER profile, my only winners). −1 each for a non-hard-line RugCheck danger, an unverified community, or a weak/LARP story. 5–6 = probe; under 5 = PASS naming the blocker.
- **Press the goal (owner):** take every setup that clears these rules at its honest conviction, and rate clean ones 8–9 when they earn it so code sizes them up. Pass only with a named blocker.
- **Fresh migration (<1h) going red off the bond spike:** wait for a base above the hourly low (too-new skips went 7 ran / 31 dumped, V1).
- **Vamp field:** buy only the leader by 5m volume and attention, never a 2nd/3rd copy (V1, V2; FLOATER beat 22 copies; vamp skips 1 ran / 6 dumped).
- **DIP needs a visible higher low:** bounce off the hourly low, a pullback that holds above it, price now above that pullback low. Stop goes under that higher low; if it sits >20% under entry, PASS. Never buy the first red-to-green candle (HEXN #1; "no higher low" skips 0 ran / 9 dumped).
- **DIP attention gate:** 5m ≥ 0.7x the hourly average (owner; "rising" not required), plus a live story with a real crowd. Weak or LARP tech dips are a PASS (HEXN lost twice). DIP probation is over: size by conviction.
- **Hack stories: PASS.** That covers hacked projects, exploit/drain headlines and Hack-Inu copies (owner rule).
- **Hard blocks stay:** top 10 >25%, dev >1%, bundles/insiders over the line, mint/freeze live, LP not burned, political figure (V6, V13, V17). Skips: top 10 7 ran / 31 dumped, dev 0 / 11, bundles 0 / 5, political 0 / 2.
- **Protect green trades before initials:** if 5m volume falls under half its hourly pace, sell half (CPU and FLOAT peaked ~1.6x and closed red). If a trade that already hit ~1.3x triggers a stop review, sell all of it, never trim (PILLSEY).
- **Time stop at 45 min:** exit if under 1.0x with no volume surge (V1). One exception only: a coin above $1M that is green on mcap, holding its range low, with 5m ≥ hourly pace, gets a single extension to 90 min (HYPERCHAN #2). No other extensions (FLOAT held to 158 min and lost).
- **Stop review defaults to SELL now.** Always sell if the trade never went green, or if top-10/insider share dropped while price bleeds (SI, HEXN; stops gapped to −31% to −59%). Hold once only with a visible bundle exit and the story and 5m volume clearly intact. Re-enter a stopped coin only when it reclaims the prior high, never mid-range (CATBOT buy-back −24%).
